page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred, with the page number at the top right. No marginal notes, headings, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: locus. Ac quoniam in territotiis singulis
ferè, ut per vices & successiones annuas
dum aut numerum prædiorum, quæ pos-
sident. Nam qui prædium hujusmodi u-
num tantùm tenet, unius tantùm anni
qui duo, duobus; qui plura, pluribus:
& si quis omnia, perpetuam quoque juris
dicundi potestatem eo in tribunali obti-
net: idemque valet in iis, qui jus illud
veteri instituto plane contrarium sit, pe-
quod olim multorum fuit, nunc ad solos

page.notes: No marginal notes. The faint grey text at the lower right is the digitiser's watermark and has been left out. Printed irregularities kept as printed: "territotiis" (for territoriis), "successêre" written with a long-s form in the print, and the hyphenated line breaks "pos-sident", "u-num", "obti-net", "pe-cuniâ", "deni-que", "vi-corumq;". Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout.
